dogecoin.text:

$DOGE

Might be a good time to buy #dogecoin and #CumRocket, both are in a decent dip/correction, will possibly dip a little more, but will both go back up eventually.

 $DOGE $CUMMIES https://t.co/GsbdhlGKeN
Elon has even gone and said to be careful when investing in crypto, because it's volatile. He has never told people to buy $DOGE.

Anybody complaining about him being the cause of a $DOGE pump and dump, it's not his fault people got wrecked. I pumped dogecoin and doubled my investment, then pulled out 3 days ago. We all knew it was buy the rumour, sell the news. Never invest what you can't afford to lose.

The issue that's preventing crypto from becoming mainstream isn't the memecoins like #DOGECOIN making it seem like a joke, or people getting wrecked. It's the down time of all the exchanges, such as Binance earlier and now @cryptocom. The experience is absolute horse shit. (1/2)
